answers.core:
This is not really a high-priority issue, especially because we have some workarounds. But given the fact that it's a recurring long-term problem and can basically happen in any project that uses inheritance, it would be nice to have to improve the editor experience.

Here are some issues that have been created on the Godot repository:

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/20802
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/30024
answers.workaround:
There are some workarounds for it:

- Use the` merge from scene` option on the inherited scene, selecting only the nodes that we have to copy.
- Use the option `clear inheritance` on the root node of the inherited scene, copy the intended nodes, close the scene without saving, open the scene again and paste it.

In addition to being obviously more labour-intensive options, they are also not very intuitive.

title: Enable duplicating/copying nodes on inherited scenes
